description: This file defines the HomeScreen component in a React Native app, displaying category tabs and a list of videos. It manages UI states, handles data loading, refresh actions, and navigation to a detail screen, with error and empty state handling.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Simulates a refresh action, updating the refreshing state after a delay.

methods.name: handleCardPress
methods.description: Navigates to the Video Detail screen with the selected video ID.

methods.name: EmptyContent
methods.description: Renders UI when no videos are found in the selected category.

methods.name: ErrorContent
methods.description: Renders UI when there's an error loading data.
